title.quote: Fairness Through Domain Awareness: Mitigating Popularity Bias For Music Discovery
title.justification: Title as given on the paper
title.value: Fairness Through Domain Awareness: Mitigating Popularity Bias For Music Discovery

extractions.description: The paper proposes BOOST, a domain-aware individual fairness approach extending the REDRESS ranking-based individual fairness framework to bipartite graph recommendation, to mitigate popularity bias in GNN-based music recommender systems. It augments two public music datasets (MPD and LastFM) with multi-modal track features scraped from the Spotify API (sonic, genre, BERT track-name embeddings, ResNet50 album-art embeddings) and evaluates against group-fairness, counterfactual and re-ranking baselines on playlist continuation and weekly discovery tasks in the cold start setting.

type.quote: Through a series of empirical results, we show that our fairness framework enables us to outperform a series of accepted fairness benchmarks
type.justification: The paper runs experiments comparing methods on two datasets with metrics and significance tests.
